blocks.text: PROSPERIDAD, Agusan del Sur — With gadgets and social media making it effortless to publish without checking facts, the Public Relations Society of the Philippines (PRSP) is pushing ethics rules, training, and youth outreach to counter black propaganda, paid troll operations, and AI-driven misinformation while acknowledging limits on who the group can police.
